notes: The model was produced between 2016 and 2019 and sold through 2022.

method: Lumafield CT-scanned five units (PB1-PB5; PB1, PB2, PB3 recalled) and found three 18650 cells in each.
CPSC gives the US online sale window as June 2016 to December 2022.

comps.spec: Three 18650 lithium-ion cells per unit; cells from at least two suppliers; at least two cell versions. PB3 (recalled) cells have a mandrel, reinforcement foil and three larger vent openings; PB1, PB2, PB4, PB5 have four smaller ones.

Tab bus bars connect the cell terminals in all five units. PB1-PB3 (recalled) use flat tab wire for the entire connection to the PCB; PB4 and PB5 use conventional insulated wires. Positive-to-negative bus bar gap: 0.52 mm (PB1), 1.12 mm (PB2), 1.58 mm (PB3).

sources.title: Lumafield: What Went Wrong Inside These Recalled Power Banks (CT scan of PowerCore 10000 A1263, units PB1-PB5)
